selection_text: Each year, the Triangle Gator Club® awards merit and need-based scholarships to exceptional Triangle-area high school graduates heading to Gainesville, directly supporting their academic pursuits and representing the best of North Carolina at UF.
hero_subtext: The Triangle Gator Club® Endowment is a lasting commitment to support the next generation of Gator leaders from central North Carolina. Designed to ease the burden of out-of-state tuition, this scholarship awards merit- and need-based financial aid to exceptional Triangle-area high school graduates heading to the University of Florida. By investing in our $10,000 goal by 2030, your tax-deductible contribution directly empowers bright local students to thrive in Gainesville while strengthening our Gator community right here at home.
covers_text: We are proud to announce the launch of the Triangle Gator Club® Endowment, a lasting commitment to supporting the next generation of Gator leaders from central North Carolina. Designed to open doors for outstanding local high school graduates attending the University of Florida, this endowment provides vital financial assistance to help ease the burden of out-of-state tuition.
cta_text:
Your generosity directly impacts local students, ensuring bright young minds have the resources they need to thrive at UF. By contributing to the endowment, you invest in future leaders and strengthen the Gator Nation right here at home.

The Triangle Gator Club® is a registered 501(c)(3) organization, and all contributions are tax-deductible.
eligibility_text: To build a sustainable future for our community, we have set an ambitious goal: $10,000 raised by 2030. By securing this foundation, we ensure continuous funding for deserving students while helping sustain our local operations, allowing us to serve, connect, and engage Triangle Gators for years to come.
